fields.description: Surface elevation relative to sea level
fields.name: elevation

fields.description: Annual mean surface temperature (after a solve)
fields.name: temperature

params.description: World shape: sphere, cube or flat plane
params.name: shape

params.description: Mesh resolution level (sphere: icosahedron subdivisions; cube: 4 x level cells per edge; plane: 16 x 8 x level cells)
params.name: resolution

params.description: Planet radius (cube: half side; plane: width = circumference)
params.name: radius_km

params.description: Seed for the terrain; same seed and inputs give the same world
params.name: seed

params.description: Share of the surface (by area) that lies below sea level
params.name: ocean_fraction

params.description: Rotation period (0 = no rotation: a static sun, e.g. tidally locked)
params.name: day_length_h

params.description: Orbital period (0 = no orbit: no seasons)
params.name: year_length_days

params.description: Years of 12 seasons run before the climate normals are taken (the last one is the result)
params.name: spinup_years

presets.description: Earth-like: 70% ocean, 24 h day, 365 day year, 23.4 degree tilt
presets.name: earthlike

presets.description: Desert world: little ocean, a stronger sun
presets.name: desert

presets.description: Tidally locked: static sun, no seasons, no tilt
presets.name: tidally_locked

presets.description: Ice age: a dimmer sun, more tilt
presets.name: ice_age
